footnote_text: On October 15, 2026, the Reporting Person was awarded a total of 228 restricted share units ("RSUs") pursuant to the terms of the Issuer's Share Election Program whereby directors elect to receive equity in lieu of cash compensation and as approved by Issuer's Board of Directors and Shareholders on 7/24/2013 and 7/29/2013, respectively. The award was granted for the quarterly period from 07/01/2026 to 09/30/2026. The award vested immediately upon grant. || Includes 2,338 unvested RSUs, which shall vest in full on the date immediately prior to the date of the Issuer's 2027 annual general meeting. Each unvested RSU represents a contingent right to receive one unrestricted, fully transferrable share for each vested RSU which has not been previously forfeited.
